signature: SUBROUTINE DSBTRD( VECT, UPLO, N, KD, AB, LDAB, D, E, Q, LDQ,

params.name: vect
uplo
params.reference:
-   `= 'U'`: Upper triangle of A is stored;
-   `= 'L'`: Lower triangle of A is stored.

params.name: N
params.reference: The order of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$.

params.name: kd
params.reference: The number of superdiagonals of the matrix A if `UPLO = 'U'`, or the number of subdiagonals if `UPLO = 'L'`. $\mathrm{KD} \ge 0$.

params.name: AB
params.reference: On entry, the upper or lower triangle of the symmetric band matrix A, stored in the first `KD`+1 rows of the array. The j-th column of A is stored in the j-th column of the array `AB` as follows: if `UPLO = 'U'`, `AB(kd+1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $\max (1,j-\mathrm{kd}) \le i \le j$; if `UPLO = 'L'`, `AB(1+i-j,j) = A(i,j)` for $j \le i \le \min (n,j+\mathrm{kd})$. On exit, the diagonal elements of `AB` are overwritten by the diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T; if $\mathrm{KD} > 0$, the elements on the first superdiagonal (if `UPLO = 'U'`) or the first subdiagonal (if `UPLO = 'L'`) are overwritten by the off-diagonal elements of T; the rest of `AB` is overwritten by values generated during the reduction.

params.name: ldab
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array `AB`. $\mathrm{LDAB} \ge \mathrm{KD}+1$.

params.name: d
params.reference: The diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T.

params.name: e
params.reference: The off-diagonal elements of the tridiagonal matrix T: $E(i) = T(i,i+1)$ if `UPLO = 'U'`; $E(i) = T(i+1,i)$ if `UPLO = 'L'`.

params.name: Q
params.reference:
On entry, if `VECT = 'U'`, then Q must contain an N-by-N matrix X; if `VECT = 'N'` or 'V', then Q need not be set.

On exit: if `VECT = 'V'`, Q contains the N-by-N orthogonal matrix Q; if `VECT = 'U'`, Q contains the product $X \, Q$; if `VECT = 'N'`, the array Q is not referenced.

params.name: ldq
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array Q. $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge 1$, and $\mathrm{LDQ} \ge N$ if `VECT = 'V'` or 'U'.

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `< 0`: if `INFO = -i`, the i-th argument had an illegal value
